_comment: Candidate AOI (not final). Grid CRS = Equirectangular Mars 2000 Sphere IAU (R=3396190 m, lat_ts=0, lon_0=0), same as USGS Mars2020 TRN products. Coordinates snapped to whole metres on the HiRISE 1 m grid and 20 m CTX grid edges are NOT matched (CTX origin is fractional).
aoi_rationale: Western Jezero delta front: candidate cluster of Perseverance delta-front campaign sites (Hawksbill Gap, Enchanted Lake, Three Forks, Skinner/Wildcat Ridge) per a THIRD-PARTY landmark CSV; coordinates must be verified against NASA/JPL sources before being used as science targets.
